sanskrit: ॐ पार्थाय प्रतिबोधितां भगवता नारायणेन स्वयं
english: oṃ pārthāya pratibodhitāṃ bhagavatā nārāyaṇena svayam
slokas.meaning: O Bhagavad Gita, with which Pārtha was enlightened by the Lord Narayana Himself and which was composed by the ancient sage Vyasa in the middle of the Mahabharata; the Goddess who showers the nectar of non-duality, containing eighteen chapters; O Mother, I meditate on Thee, the destroyer of rebirth.
